newsitem.title: CANADA: Taro sells unit to Energy Ventures.
newsitem.headline: Taro sells unit to Energy Ventures.

text.p: Taro Industries Ltd said on Monday it sold its Griffin Legrand subsidiary to a unit of Houston, Texas-based Energy Ventures Inc for C$29.3 million.
The sale price was made up of C$28.7 million in cash plus the assumption of C$0.6 million of obligations.
Taro said because the sale price was larger than its carrying value on the asset, the transaction will result in a small pre-tax gain, and a loss of C$1.0 million after taxess.
After the deal, Taro's net book value per share will be C$6.24 and tangible book value -- net value without goodwill -- will rise by more than C$2 a share to C$5.38.
After paying bank debt and paying taxes on the sale, Taro will have more than C$16 million in cash.
Griffin Legrand, which provides artificial lift products for the oil industry and produces cavity pump systems and conventional pumpjacks, posted sales for 1996 of C$42.5 million.
